connector.name: Promptheus
connector.registryDescription: AI-powered prompt refinement with adaptive questioning and multi-provider support (6+ LLM backends)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package promptheus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the abhichandra21 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
